title: Specimen type block-count model
description: Output of specimen_analysis.py: per specimen type id, its share of cases (overall and per weekday) and the best-fitting block-count-per-case distribution.

frequency.description: Share of cases among the reported specimen types; sums to 1 over all entries.

dow_frequency.description: Share of cases per ISO weekday (1 = Monday ... 5 = Friday), shrunk toward frequency; for each weekday it sums to 1 over all entries.

distribution.description: Distribution family name, see DISCRETE and CONTINUOUS in specimen_analysis.py.

scipy.description: Name of the scipy.stats distribution, e.g. nbinom or lognorm.

params.description: scipy.stats parameters by name. Continuous families also carry loc and scale and are discretised as P(k) = F(k + 0.5) - F(k - 0.5).

support.description: Smallest and largest observed block count; synthetic block counts stay within it.
